acquisition_note: Transcribed from a literal TestPair list, extracted by script rather than retyped, then every stateless field was re-derived independently from the plan section 7 offsets and compared against TMIW's asserted values. All eight agree exactly on elapsedSeconds, elapsedMillis and calories.
upstream_status: DISABLED UPSTREAM. Both data groups in schwinn_x70_test.dart -- lines 42 to 266 -- sit inside a block comment. Only the constructor and flag tests run. TMIW therefore ships no active parity coverage for this decoder, which puts the x70 in the same position as Kayak First rather than the position plan section 7 assumed when it asked for parity against this file.
console_note: These eight vectors are all 17-byte main-stream frames, so they are 270 and 570u evidence only. A Schwinn 170 emits no 17-byte stream at all; its paired 20- and 14-byte frames are captured separately in fixtures/hardware/schwinn_170_paired.json.
framing_note: Byte 0 is not a magic number: 0x11 is 17, the frame length, and both known initialization commands are length-prefixed the same way (V17). TMIW's 'magic prefix' conflates a length byte with a two-byte type tag.
what_is_confirmed: The stateless layout. Time at 8-9 divided by 1024 reproduces TMIW's elapsed and elapsedMillis on all eight vectors, and calories at 10-15 divided by 2097152 reproduces its calorie count on all eight. Resistance at byte 16 is present and never below 1.
what_is_not_confirmed: Every stateful derivation. TMIW's asserted cadence is 0 in all eight cases and its asserted power reaches 4538 W with speed 102.6 km/h, which is not physically possible on a spin bike. The explanation is that these vectors are sparse, non-consecutive samples from long sessions -- the 16-bit tick counter rolls over every 64 seconds -- so no valid inter-frame delta exists and the cadence window is fed nonsense, which is very likely why the author disabled the block. Do not port cadence, power or speed expectations from this corpus; they are model output from a broken input, not observations.
calorie_note: The 2097152 divisor reproduces TMIW's own expected values, which is circular -- those expectations were generated by the same code. Provenance for 2^21 remains unrecorded and plan section 7's instruction not to publish x70 calories stands.
superseded_note: Retained as the record of what the reference project shipped, and as the provenance trail for the plan's original section 7 layout. For decoding work prefer the captured corpora in fixtures/hardware/: those frames are consecutive and time-stamped, so cadence and energy rate are derivable, which is exactly what these eight sparse samples cannot support.
